description: This Java class defines configuration settings for HTTP in the Eclipse Ditto Gateway service, including hostname, port, supported schema versions, HTTPS redirection policies, CORS, timeouts, and query parameter handling.

classes.name: GatewayHttpConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing HTTP configuration for the Gateway service, including hostname, port, schema versions, HTTPS policies, CORS, timeouts, header handling, and media types.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of GatewayHttpConfig from a given Config, applying fallback to default configurations.

methods.name: getCoordinatedShutdownTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for coordinated shutdown.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the set of supported JSON schema versions.

methods.name: isRedirectToHttps
methods.description: Indicates whether redirect to HTTPS is enabled.

methods.name: getRedirectToHttpsBlocklistPattern
methods.description: Provides the pattern for URLs to exclude from HTTPS redirection.

methods.name: getRequestTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for requests.

methods.name: getActorPropsFactoryFullQualifiedClassname
methods.description: Returns the full class name for actor properties factory.

methods.name: getQueryParametersAsHeaders
methods.description: Returns the set of query parameters treated as headers.
